summaryEn: Teaches you to compare two things and the ending the adjective takes.
Teaches you to pick the best of them all and to talk about discounts.
Teaches you to state a preference while trying clothes on and to decide between two options.
Teaches you the first step of adjective declension, with colours and patterns.
Teaches you to say what you want at the hairdresser's and to judge the result.
Teaches you to complain about a faulty product and to ask for a refund.
Teaches you to compare tariffs and to ask about the terms of a contract.
Teaches you to open an account at the bank and to talk about money matters.
Teaches you to choose how to send something and to talk about the weight.
Teaches you to haggle over second-hand things and to ask what condition they are in.
Teaches you to plan a journey and to describe the route.
Teaches you to check in at a hotel and to ask about the room.
Teaches you to say what went into the suitcase and what was forgotten.
Teaches you to describe the steps at the airport and what you have to do.
Teaches you to describe the weather and to make a forecast in the future tense.
Teaches you to plan a day trip and to make it depend on a condition.
Teaches you to ask what a campsite has and what it does not.
Teaches you to describe the places on a city tour and their history.
Teaches you to discuss who gets what and to choose a souvenir.
Teaches you to describe something going wrong on a journey and to find another way.
Teaches you to celebrate a birthday and to give the date.
Teaches you to plan a celebration together and to share out the jobs.
Teaches you to discuss what to bring to an invitation and who to give it to.
Teaches you to say who is who at a wedding and to offer congratulations.
Teaches you to describe the celebrations in Germany and to compare them.
Teaches you to decline an invitation politely and to suggest another date.
Teaches you to pay a compliment, to reply to one and to get the pronoun case right.
Teaches you to describe an argument, to apologise and to make up.
Teaches you to talk about keeping in touch with family far away and about missing them.
Teaches you to talk about new year's resolutions and realistic goals.
Teaches you the conditional clause and how to describe a habit with it.
Teaches you to recommend a series or a programme and to say what you liked.
Teaches you to pass a news story on and to question whether it is true.
Teaches you to describe your social media habits and to tie them to a condition.
Teaches you the verbs that call for a particular preposition, and how to talk about waiting.
Teaches you to describe a computer problem and to give instructions step by step.
Teaches you to show photos and to pick the one everyone likes best.
Teaches you to describe your interests and the reflexive verb that takes a preposition.
Teaches you the technical trouble on a video call and the formal language it is held in.
Teaches you to describe a day without a phone and to say how the experience was.
Teaches you to register your address and to answer the official's questions.
Teaches you to understand the instructions you meet while filling in a form.
Teaches you to describe the wait at an office and the language of a written complaint.
Teaches you to understand the library rules and to look for a book.
Teaches you to enrol on a course and to make plans in the future tense.
Teaches you to talk about your plans for the future and to put your goals in order.
Teaches you to describe the job you dream of and to give your reasons.
Teaches you to compare cultural differences and to describe what you have noticed.
Teaches you to describe the nerves before an exam and to talk about your preparation.
Teaches you to sum up the road you have travelled and to look back on a stage.
